technical_requirement: Platform architecture components comply with the Regulation
Authority access only by secure machine-to-machine connection through an eFTI Gate; connect to at least one Gate
Validate Gate access/follow-up requests using Gate security key
Resolve CMDS UUID and authority access-right subset identifiers
Retain audit trail for follow-up communication including request ID and receipt timestamp
Permit business access by human interface and/or secure tributary-system M2M
Identify authenticate and authorise onboarded and temporary non-onboarded users
Repeat identification authentication and authorisation for each session before processing
Use authorisation registry and/or temporary-rights mechanism
Maintain authorisation registries as a separate secure component internal or external to platform
Uniquely identify user profiles and scope operation time and data-element rights
Retain authorisation records for at least the applicable CMDS availability period
Delete personal data within reasonable time after retention period
Establish secure DIWASS or eligible Member State local-system connection for covered waste information
Provide authorised notifications/reports on authority access follow-up and business processing
Authorised users can create edit read download sign stamp and archive CMDS as applicable
Support applicable waste-document download and carrier confirmations
Provide authorised human-readable copies for inspection
Copy includes machine-readable certification mark reference and download timestamp
Human interface protects against unattended or uncontrolled-device access
Remain available to authorities while CMDS is active and where applicable inactive
Maintain compliant eDelivery/equivalent Gate access point and validate Gate keys/certificates
Use Member-State-issued security certificate tied to platform compliance certificate
Gate exchanges comply with 2024/1942 message specifications
Secure keys/certificates for tributary and external ICT systems
Secure DIWASS access points and consignee-signature receiving API where applicable
Physical storage has capacity backup physical protection recovery and vulnerability management
Cloud providers follow major security and personal-data practices
Store eFTI data within the Union or EU/Member State jurisdiction
